e: Bismillah!Al Hamdulillah!Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! Fact 1: A Mujaheed is in Jahannam for committing suicide: It is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa’d al-Sa’idi that there was an encounter between Rasu
x: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! Fact 1: A Mujaheed is in Jahannam for committing suicide: It is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa’d al-Sa’idi that there was an encounter between Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam and the Mushrikeen, and they fought. At the conclusion of the battle Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam bent his steps towards his army and they (the enemies) bent their steps towards their army. And there was a person among the Companions of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam who did not spare a detached (fighter of the enemy) but pursued and killed him with the sword. The Companions said: “None served us better today than this man”. Upon this Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam remarked: “Verily he is one of the denizens of Fire.” One of the people (Muslims) said: “I will constantly shadow him”. Then, this man went out along with him. He halted whenever he halted, and ran along with him whenever he ran. He (the narrator) said: The man was seriously injured. He (could not stand the pain) and hastened his own death. He placed the blade of the sword on the ground with the tip between his chest and then pressed himself against the sword and killed himself. The man (following him) went to Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam and said: “I bear testimony that verily you’re the Messenger of Allah”. He, Rasulullah said: “What is the matter?” He replied: “The person about whom you just mentioned that he was one among the denizens of Fire and the people were surprised (at this) and I said to them that I would bring (the news about him) and consequently I went out in search of him till I (found him ) to be very seriously injured. He hastened his death. He placed the blade of the sword upon the ground and its tip between his chest and then pressed himself against that and killed himself.” Thereupon Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam remarked: “A person performs the deeds which to the people appear to be the deeds befitting the dweller of Paradise, but he is in fact one of the denizens of Hell. And verily a person does an act which in the eyes of the public is one which is done by the denizens of Hell, but the person is one among the dwellers of Paradise”. (Saheeh Muslim Hadith No. 206 – 179/112) So, a Mujaheed is in Jahannam because he killed himself. But now, let’s read another hadith of the suicide of a Muhajeer. Fact 2: A Muhajeer is in Jannah even after he committed suicide: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that Tufail, son of Amr al-Dausi came to Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam and said: “Do you need strong, fortified protection? The tribe of Daus had a fort in the pre-Islamic days.” Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam declined this offer since it (the privilege of protecting Rasulullah) had already been reserved for the Ansar. When Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam migrated to Medina, Tufail, son of Amr also migrated to that place, and there also migrated along with him a man of his tribe. But the climate of Medina did not suit him, and he fell sick. He felt very uneasy. So he took hold of an iron head of an arrow and cut his finger joints. The blood streamed forth from his hands, till he died. Tufail, son of Amr saw him in a dream. His state was good and he saw him with his hands wrapped. He (Tufail) said to him: “What treatment did your Allah accord to you?” He replied: “Allah granted me pardon for my migration to Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam.” He (Tufail) again said: “What is this that I see you wrapping up your hands?” He replied: “I was told (by Allah): We would not set right anything of yours which you damaged yourself.” Tufail narrated this (dream) to Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam. Upon this, Rasulullah prayed: “O Allah I grant pardon even to his hands.” (Saheeh Muslim 211-184/116) Subhanallah! What do you understand from this? Committing suicide is such a crime that even a Mujaheed is not forgiven but a Muhajeer is! SubhanAllah! Wa Allahu A’lam. May Allah make us among the Muhajireen. May Allah forgive our sins.

t: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 03: How important it is to move away from living among the Mushrikeen?
e: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|::|: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :|: Bismillah!Al Hamdulillah!Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! How important is the matter of not living with the Mushrikeen?How important are the wor
x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :|: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :|: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! How important is the matter of not living with the Mushrikeen? How important are the words of a person what he speaks as the last advice before his death? These are such important words that even these words get a legal status, in case you don’t know it. Then, what about the instructions of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam on his deathbed? How important could that be for the Ummah? For sure, It is the most important legal binding on the Ummah, the most important Shariah of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam. So, what was the last message of Rasulullah at the last moments of his death? “Expel the Mushrikeen from the territory of Arabia.” Subhanallah! Why did this matter become such important to Rasulullah? It’s because He was concerned about his Ummah so much that he wanted to give a final prescription, and the final Shariah for his Ummah to stay on the right path! So, he prescribed, “Do three things so that you won’t go astray” And the first instruction was this: “Expel the Mushrikeen from the territory of Arabia.” What’s the meaning of it? It means he did not want his Ummah to be among the Mushrikeen or He did not want the Mushrikeen around the Muslims. Because he knew that living around the Mushrikeen would lead them to go astray, lead them to engage in Shirk, the greatest sin of all. And what do you see today? How many Muslims and Muslim kids take part in one way or another in the pagan rituals of Halloween, Santa, and Christmas rituals? How many Muslim youths in Bangladesh, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Indonesia take part in Hindu pagan rituals? And soon the Muslims of the Arabian peninsula would engage or take part in these rituals as the present authorities of the kingdoms allowing the Mushrikeen to build their worship places in the lands of Islam. So, no wonder, why won’t you see the Muslims gone astray today? They are not only living among the Mushrikeen, rather they are living under the authority of the Mushrikeen! (In the Kuffar’s land and then, whoever it applies to) Thus we are witnessing the consequences that Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam warned about. Let’s cite a few of such scenarios here: Scenario 1: This author himself witnessed a business house owned and run by Muslims, decorated with Christmas decorations during this festival of Shirk. Scenario 2: An 11-year-old girl asks her parents to put a Christmas tree in the house, And the Jaheel parents ask Fatwa about it : That’s why it is so important to move away from living under the authority of the Mushrikeen and from living among the Mushrikeen, saving yourself and your generations from Shirk. And Allah knows best. May Allah protect us from going astray. May Allah save us from living among the Mushrikeen. May Allah make our Hijrah easy. Ameen. Here is the full text of the Hadith: Saheeh Muslim 4124 (20/1637) Sa’id b. Jubair reported that Ibn ‘Abbas said: Thursday, (and then said): What is this Thursday? He then wept so much that his tears moistened the pebbles. I said: Ibn ‘Abbas, what is (significant) about Thursday? He (Ibn ‘Abbas) said: The illness of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam took a serious turn (on this day), and he said: “Come to me, so that I should write for you a document that you may not go astray after me.” They (the Companions around him) disputed, and it is not meet to dispute in the presence of Rasulullah. They said: How is (Rasulillah)? Has he lost his consciousness? Try to learn from him (this point). He (Rasulillah) said: “Leave me. I am better in the state (than the one in which you are engaged). I make a will about three things: Turn out the polytheists from the territory of Arabia; show hospitality to the (foreign) delegations as I used to show them hospitality.” He (the narrator) said: He (Ibn Abbas) kept silent on the third point, or he (the narrator) said: But I forgot that. This hadith was mentioned through another chain. — Also in Saheeh Bukhari 3053 stated: Rasulullah on his death-bed, gave three orders saying, “Expel the pagans from the Arabian Peninsula” Also in Saheeh Bukhari 4486 stated: It has been narrated by ‘Umar bin. al-Khattib that he heard Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “I will expel the Jews and Christians from the Arabian Peninsula and will not leave any but Muslim.” Please note: There is another hadith (Saheeh Muslim 4126) narrated from a different chain that doesn’t say Rasulullah Sallallahu Alahi Wa Sallam was able to write because of interference from Umar Radiallahu Anhu. But how do we reconcile these Hadiths? By the intention of Rasulullah and later the actions of the Sahaba. We know from history that no Mushrikeen were allowed to live in the Arabian peninsula. Therefore, the implementation of the Hadiths itself proves the authenticity of these Hadiths mentioned above. And Allah knows best. https://islamqa.info/en/answers/22633/the-jews-have-no-right-to-enter-the-arabian-peninsula باب تَرْكِ الْوَصِيَّةِ لِمَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ ‏‏ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ – وَاللَّفْظُ لِسَعِيدٍ – قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ ثُمَّ بَكَى حَتَّى بَلَّ دَمْعُهُ الْحَصَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ قَالَ اشْتَدَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏”‏ ائْتُونِي أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدِي ‏”‏ ‏.‏ فَتَنَازَعُوا وَمَا يَنْبَغِي عِنْدَ نَبِيٍّ تَنَازُعٌ ‏.‏ وَقَالُوا مَا شَأْنُهُ أَهَجَرَ اسْتَفْهِمُوهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏”‏ دَعُونِي فَالَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ خَيْرٌ أُوصِيكُمْ بِثَلاَثٍ أَخْرِجُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَأَجِيزُوا الْوَفْدَ بِنَحْوِ مَا كُنْتُ أُجِيزُهُمْ ‏”‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَكَتَ عَنِ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ قَالَهَا فَأُنْسِيتُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ

t: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 05: You don’t help the Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims and plotting against Islam.
e: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|::|: Is Allah Not Your RABB? :|::|: ‘Muslims’ Obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|: BismillahAl HamdulillahWa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah Allah said, “DO NOT obey the Kuffar.“(Al-Furqan 25:52) But
x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :|: Is Allah Not Your RABB? :|: :|: ‘Muslims’ Obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|: Bismillah Al Hamdulillah Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah Allah said, “DO NOT obey the Kuffar. “ (Al-Furqan 25:52) But you? You are not only obeying, you’re submitting yourself to Kuffar’s Sharia’ . Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “ Whoever takes arms against us, he is not from us “ (Saheeh Bukhari 6874) But you? You’re part of the Kuffar’s oppression in killing of Muslims and you’re aiding the Kuffar in plotting against Muslims. And Allah said the consequence of obeying the Kuffar: “ They will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers “. (Ale Imran 3:149) For sure, you really are in a dangerous situation, those who are living and settling under Kuffar’s authority. You are involved in two major crimes. Obeying, submitting yourself to the ‘ Kuffar's Sharia ‘. And following ‘ Kuffar's Deen ‘. And knowingly or unknowingly helping Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims, and aiding them in plotting against Islam. These crimes could be accounted for as Kufr. Allahu A’lam. Let me explain. (1) Submitting to Kuffar’s Deen: This is already explained. If you would like to know, please click this link: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 02: Allah ordered, “Do not obey the Kuffar” but you wholeheartedly submitted to ‘Kuffar’s Deen’, to ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’. (2) And knowingly or unknowingly helping Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims and aiding them in plotting against Islam: How do you get involved in it? To get to a clear understanding of this, let’s do a Critical Reasoning of this Hadith. Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said, “ Whoever takes arms against us, he is not from us “ (Saheeh Bukhari 6874) Who is Rasulullah talking about here, A Kafir? No! A Kafir is already not ‘from us’. Then, who else is He talking about? A Muslim. When a Muslim takes arms against the Ummah of Muslims, he doesn’t belong to Islam anymore. How does this issue relate to Hijrah? Well, it does. Let me explain. The one who helps commit a crime, is he also guilty of the crime? Yes! The one who helps in murder, is he also guilty of murder? Yes! Then, those who fight Muslims , aren’t aiding them also means fighting along with them? You do the math! Let me put it in a way so that a 13-year-old can understand the issue easily. There’s a million-dollar masjid project. You give only $10 Sadaqah. Why? Expecting Sadaqah Jaariah, continuous reward of your portion of $10. Expecting Allah will reward you abundantly. Thinking, maybe just this Sadaqah would be a cause of your saving from Jahannam. So, put this scenario in your portion of the Tax that these Kuffar governments use for. These are the money that governments use to maintain their state affairs, right? Isn’t it then easy to understand that you get a proportionate share of all the evil they do against Muslims and against humanity? The propagation of Zina, alcohol, gambling and whatnot and the example of LGBTQ is just before your eyes right now. Is there any doubt that you will get a proportionate share of all these evils? And then, what about their forces that fight against Muslims? Where do those campaigns get funded from? What about their secret forces that are relentlessly plotting and propagating against Islam? Who funded those organisations? It is from the tax money that they collect from their people, and you have a proportionate share in that. That’s how you are helping them in killing and oppressing Muslims. That’s how you’re aiding them in plotting against Islam. And that’s how this Hadith applies to you: you carry arms against Muslims. Allahu A’lam. Therefore, calculate your status. You do the math. I know, you don’t give up yet. You might be thinking, ‘I am just a victim of the system. I didn’t choose to live in this system. I was born in this system. What can I do? Well, think this way, a Kafir is also born in a Kuffar family. Can he place his argument in front of Al-Hakeem on the day of judgement, “I was just a victim, I was born in a Kafir family, you put me in a Kafir family” You know that this won’t work. He has to seek the truth and then, when he finds the truth, he has to change his entire lifestyle to claim his Jannah, to save himself from Jahannam. He sometimes has to go through challenges such as leaving his own family, friends, and society. Can you even imagine the plight of those new Muslims? And your situation is not worse than the newly reverted Muslims. You know it. Remember this: there are millions of oppressed Muslims out there raising their hands against the oppressors, and for sure, you’re aiding those oppressors through your tax money while Allah instructed you to stand by the side of your oppressed brothers and do Jihad against the oppressors. But you, one way or another, are knowingly or unknowingly aiding those oppressors. Therefore, you have only one way out of this calamity. Hijrah! Hijrah, away from obeying and submitting to the ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’ and away from aiding the Kuffar in their oppression of Muslims. My brother, It’s time for Hijrah! May Allah not make us among those who aid the Kuffar in oppressing and fighting the Muslims. May Allah make our Hijrah easy. Ameen.

t: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 02: Allah ordered, “Do not obey the Kuffar” but you wholeheartedly submitted to ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’, following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’.
e: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|::|: Is Allah Not Your RABB? :|::|: Muslims In Kuffar’s Mindset :|::|: Muslims Following Kuffar’s Deen :|::|: Muslims OBEYING ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|::|: WHO Do You Submit? :|::|: Quran For Critica
x: :|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|: :|: Is Allah Not Your RABB? :|: :|: Muslims In Kuffar’s Mindset :|: :|: Muslims Following Kuffar’s Deen :|: :|: Muslims OBEYING ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|: :|: WHO Do You Submit? :|: :|: Quran For Critical Reasoning :|: :|: Quran Study ONE AYAH a Day :|: :|: Time For Hijrah :|: Disclaimer/ Legend: ‘You’ includes the author himself. Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! Allah ordered, “ Do not obey the Kuffar ” (Sura Al-Insan 76:24). But you wholeheartedly submitted to the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’. Allah even warned His prophet, Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam, “O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the Kuffar and the Munafiqeen . Verily Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise. (Sura Al-Ahzab 33:2) But you’re profoundly following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’. Kuffar have rejected Allah’s Deen, instead, they set their own Deen. Allah sent Shariah for what is the obligation for you to pay on your wealth which is. 2.5% on the yearly balance to pay to the authority of the Muslims, you know it. Kuffar said, ‘No! We reject that. We have our own Sharia’. ‘You have to pay us such and such percentage on your sales and transactions, whether you make a profit or not’, ‘You have to pay us such and such amount of TAX from your earnings whether you have gained anything or not at the end of the year’. Allah sent Shariah forbidding Insurance, but Kuffar said, ‘No! We reject your Sharia’ ‘You have to obey our ‘Shariah’! ‘You have to have insurance’. In Allah’s Shariah, a child becomes an adult upon reaching puberty and he/she comes under all legal bindings that apply to an adult, but Kuffar says, ‘No! We reject your Allah’s Sharia’ ‘You have to follow our ‘ Shariah ‘! ‘You have to treat a human as a child up to 18 years of age’. So, you are obeying ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ now. You can’t give your daughter to a marriage below 18 years of age. If you do Kuffar will put you in jail. And then, when you fall into any incident, such as ‘family violence’, oppression, robbery, fighting, killing, murder, etc., You become subject to the Kuffar’s law, You submit to Kuffar’s Deen, You appear to the court of the Kuffar’s And you stand for the judge (Taghut) as you stand in front of your Rabb. Inna Ilaihi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun. May Allah protect you from the Shirk of obeying Taghut. May Allah protect you from the Kufr of following ‘ Kuffar's Deen' . And then, while the Kuffar successfully managed to implement their 'Deen', their 'Shariah' on Muslims in the Muslim-populated lands or in the so-called Muslim lands, your job was to reject their 'Deen' , reject their ‘ Shariah ‘. Instead, you kept following Kuffar’s Deen in your own land. Even that was not enough for you, you came to the Kuffar’s lands and wholeheartedly submitted to the Kuffar’s Deen. Ask yourself, did any Kafir ever put a gun to your head to make you come to their country, obey their authority and follow their ‘Deen’, follow their ‘Shariah’? No! Rather you bring yourself under Kuffar’s authority and then, you claimed that they force their Deen on you. While Allah ordered you, “Do not obey the Kuffar”, but you submitted yourself to the Kuffar. So, ask yourself. Who do you submit to? What would be your answer to the Malaikah when you will be asked,“Man Dinuka“? (Sunan Abu Dawood 4753) Rather, you will be asked another question at the time of death, before you face the question in the Qabr. “ Wasn’t the earth spread for you ?” [al-Nisa’ 4:97] Didn’t I clearly inform you, “O my servant, my earth was specious, so worship me alone“? (Meaning, do not Shirk with me, do not give my right to others living in such a place. Move away to my spacious lands where you don’t have to give my right to others.) (Al-‘Ankabut 29:56) Think of the answer until you have breath! And before we finish this, let’s remind ourselves of a couple of Ayat on the same issue, where Allah Ajja Wa Jalla commanded again, as follows: Ash-Shu’ara’ 26:151-152 (151) وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ (152) ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ (151) And do not follow the command of the transgressors, (152) who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.” And you know how the Kuffar has spread corruption on earth. The worst of that corruption is the ocean of Riba that they pulled you and me today. Briefly saying, the only way out from that corruption is to think of off-grid living as a first step until Allah grants us Khilafah, En Shaa Allah! And when Allah grants us Khilafah? “Allah has promised those among you who believe and do righteous good deeds, that He will certainly grant them Khilafah (The AUTHORITY) in the land , as He granted it to those before them, and that He will grant them the authority to practise their DEEN which He has chosen for them. And He will surely give them in exchange a safe security after their fear (provided) they worship Me and do not do SHIRK with Me. But whoever disbelieves after this, they are the Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient to Allah)”. (Sura An-Nur 24:55) Subhanallah! This is Allah’s clear promise here. Allah will grant the Khilafah (the authority of land) to the Muslims. But certainly not to those who are willingly obeying the ‘Shaira’ of the Kuffar’, following the ‘Kuffar’s Deen’, giving Allah’s right to the Kuffar. Wa Allahu A’lam. May Allah give us understanding. May Allah save us from following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’. May Allah protect us from obeying ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’. May Allah open a way for us to live under Allah’s Sharia! May Allah make our Hijrah easy. Ameen.

t: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 04: Why settling in Kuffar’s Land is Haram?
e: Bismillah!Al Hamdulillah!Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! AsSalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu! Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam sent a Sariyyia (an expedition) to a tribe, the Mujahidun found a few
x: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! AsSalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu! Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam sent a Sariyyia (an expedition) to a tribe, the Mujahidun found a few people in prostration (to protect themselves) but they were killed. When Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam was informed of the incident, he said, أَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ يُقِيمُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. “I disown every Muslim who settles among the Mushrikeen”. (Sunan Abu Dawud 2645. Saheeh). My brother, You know that the entire Kuffar world is fighting against Islam, right? Imagine, the way Kuffar has been bombing the Muslims in the Middle East, the same way Muslim countries are bombing the Kuffar’s lands. Would you then live among the Kuffar, in the Kuffar’s Land? And if someone happens to live among the Kuffar at the time of war and therefore dies from those attacks, what would be his status with Allah, Al Haseeb, The Reckoner? Can he show an excuse to the angels, “I was in the ‘No Fighting Zone’ Sir!” Usually, when two countries fight and bombard each other, would you find any regular nationals living among the enemies, in the enemy country? No way! Both countries warn their respective citizens to evacuate long before they engage in the bombing (For example, the ongoing Israel-Filistine war and Russia-Ukraine war) To give you a practical example, imagine, the way Kuffar bombarded Iraq, the same way Iraq’s missiles and jet fighters bombarded America. Tell me, which American will go to live in Iraq or which Iraqi Muslim will go to live in America? You won’t find any. Check the history, when the confederation of the Kuffar was fighting a crusade against Muslims, did any Muslim live and settle among the Kuffar, in the Kuffar’s lands, under the Kuffar’s authority? and then, what about giving you the most recent example? Filistine and Israel are at war right now. You tell me, would any Filistine would go and live in Israel? It’s absurd, isn’t it? Then, why are you living in the Kuffar’s lands now? Is it because there’s no harm, no bombing attack coming from the Muslim countries to the Kuffar’s lands, right? Therefore, you feel safe, right! Or are you in the delusion that Kuffar is actually not fighting Islam, they are fighting the ‘terrorists’ , they are fighting to defuse the ‘Weapon of Mass Destruction’! And I hope that you are not in that delusion. The kuffar and their entire confederations are fighting the Muslims and fighting against Islam. This is the truth. If you really know this truth, then, you really won’t want to live among the Kuffar, in the Kuffar’s land, under the Kuffar’s authority if there is a fighting back from the Muslim countries with the Kuffar’s countries. So, my brother, Is this the fact that because the Kuffar’s lands are not attacked by the Muslim countries makes it permissible/ safe for you to live in the Kuffar’s lands? But what if a Muslim country starts an attack while you’re among the Kuffar, therefore, you’re subjected to that attack? In what status will you die then? What will be your status with Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala according to the Hadith quoted above? So, my brother, can you understand your status now? Think of this, Muslims who were in prostration were killed but Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam didn’t rebuke the Mujahideen for killing the Muslims, nor did He criticize them saying, “It is haram in Islam to kill innocent people” though it is true that it is Haram in Islam to kill innocent people (Quran 5:32). He neither punished them nor make a Takfir on them saying “Killing a Muslim is Kufr” though it is true that it is Kufr to kill a Muslim (except in certain events). (Quran 4:93) (Saheeh Bukhari 6785, 6865) And then, read this Ayah now. This Ayah was revealed about those Muslims who didn’t make Hijrah to Madinah and then, they were killed in Badr. “Verily, as for those whom the angels take (in death) while they are wronging themselves (as they stayed among the disbelievers even though emigration was obligatory for them), they (angels) say (to them): “In what (condition) were you?” They reply: “We were weak and oppressed on the earth.” They (angels) say: “Was not the earth of Allah spacious enough for you to emigrate therein?” Such men will find their abode in Hell — what an evil destination!” [al-Nisa’ 4:97] May Allah save us from being killed while living in the Kuffar’s land. May Allah save us from dying in the Kuffar’s lands. May Allah make our Hijrah easy! Ameen. Wa Allahu A’alam. And here is the full Hadith. بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ قَتْلِ مَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِالسُّجُودِ حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَرِيَّةً إِلَى خَثْعَمٍ فَاعْتَصَمَ نَاسٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالسُّجُودِ، فَأَسْرَعَ فِيهِمُ الْقَتْلَ قَالَ: فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَمَرَ لَهُمْ بِنِصْفِ الْعَقْلِ وَقَالَ: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ يُقِيمُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ؟ قَالَ: لَا تَرَاءَى نَارَاهُمَا قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ: رَوَاهُ هُشَيْمٌ، وَمَعْمَرٌ، وَخَالِدٌ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، وَجَمَاعَةٌ لَمْ يَذْكُرُوا جَرِيرًا صحيح دون جملة العقل

t: Why Hijrah! WARNING – 01: The FATWA – Shirk and Kufr in the Citizenship of the Kuffar’s lands
e: :|: TimeForHijrah :|::|: ‘Muslims’ In Kuffar’s MINDSET :|::|: ‘Muslims’ following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’ :|::|: Muslims obeying ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’a :|: Bismillah!Al Hamdulillah!Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! AsSalamu Ala
x: :|: TimeForHijrah :|: :|: ‘Muslims’ In Kuffar’s MINDSET :|: :|: ‘Muslims’ following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’ :|: :|: Muslims obeying ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’a :|: Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah! Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah! AsSalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu. Now, before you have to think or plan about Hijrah or for you to take this opportunity of MASS Hijrah, you have to know why you MUST do Hijrah! We are going to place the PRELUDE of this project in the next few parts of this booklet, ‘Why Hijrah!’ The Fatwa: By the Hāfidh, Shaykh al-‘Allāmah Sulaymān Ibn Nāsir al-‘Alwān (فك الله أسره). https://justpaste.it/4as44 || What’s the ruling on travelling to dār al-Kufr and attaining their citizenships? || Sheikh replied: The brother asks about residing in the lands of the kuffar to attain their citizenship. Firstly, acquiring the citizenship of the kuffar is prohibited by default in all cases. Because what it means to acquire a citizenship is to comply with their systems, making tahakum to them, and submitting to their laws, and that you become an individual from amongst them. It is not possible that a Muslim can become an individual from amongst the men of the kuffar, nor a soldier from amongst the soldiers of the kuffar. Because the condition that is to be known by ‘urf (traditions), is on the same level of a pronounced condition (for e.g. If you buy a car, by the ‘urf, it should have a steering wheel, even though you don’t have that condition in the contract). It’s not a (pronounced) condition that the kafir stipulates you becoming a soldier from among their soldiers, but this is something well-known; the condition that is to be known by ‘urf (traditions) according to the fuqaha (scholars of fiqh) is on the same level of a pronounced condition. So whenever you acquire their citizenship, then the laws of every land [you go to] would apply upon you, and the laws are mandated in all lands. For that reason, when citizenships initially came out, and some Muslims acquired citizenships due to being subjected to severe harm, and [due to] the pressure from their rulers or the torture they would face. This issue was brought up around about 60 years ago, and no one at the time differed concerning its prohibition which is astonishing [compared to our times]. Rather, they differed upon whether he becomes a kafir or not, and they had two opinions regarding that: 1 – There are those who said he becomes an apostate; by merely acquiring the citizenship, he would become an apostate. 2 – And others said he does not become an apostate, because he is Mukrah (under compulsion, fleeing torture, etc.), however, he is sinful by that (as he shouldn’t have acquired it, but rather remained in their land temporarily, Wallahu A’lam). The dispute was concerning his kufr, and it was not surrounding the prohibition of attaining it. However, the dispute now has become surrounding whether it is prohibited, is it halal or haram? And in reality, looking at it from the perspective that he is Mudtar (in serious need), the Mudtar is not required to take citizenship. Although, yes, if he was Mudtar to take citizenship in the sense that if he does not take it, he will be sent back to his and where he will be tortured, then yes in this situation he will be Mukrah. However, it is compulsory upon him to solidify in his heart not to make Tahakum to them, to make takfir of them, and to proclaim bara’ah from them. As for the issue of travelling to the lands of the kuffar: The default basic principle concerning that is prohibition according to the scholars. So this is proof that whoever remains in the lands of the kuffar, and does not make hijrah while he is able to migrate, then he has fallen into one of the major sins. However, Imam al-Bukhari, Abu Hatim, Abu Zur’ah, at-Tirmidhi Tirmidhi and ad-Daraqutni, declared that this report is Mursal, and what is correct is that it is from the narration of: Isma’il ibn Abi Khalid > from Qays ibn Hazim > from the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم). And Qays ibn Hazim is Mukhadram (someone who lived in the time of jahiliyyah and era of the Rasul but did not meet him to become a sahabi, but still accepted Islam). And his Mursal narrations are from the strongest of Marasil (Mursal narrations), therefore this is included with the other proofs to prove the prohibition of travelling to the lands of the kuffar. But if an individual had a need to travel to the land of the kuffar, such as for trade or treatment and so forth, he must take into account several matters: To display his deenn, by making Bara’ah from them. 2 – That he is able to protect himself from fitnah. Therefore whoever is not able to protect himself from fitnah, then he is prohibited from travelling to their lands. 3 – That this is for a need. 4 – That his journey expires when his need is fulfilled. As for those who travel to lands which might be called ‘Islamic states’: Most people today cannot differentiate between an Islamic state and a kafir state. So they call a land which does not rule by what Allah has revealed as an Islamic state, that even the Rafidi state, the state of Iran is called an ‘Islamic Republic’, because they do not differentiate between Islam, shirk, and kufr. They simply go by labels, and what the newspapers portray to them, that is what they go towards and mimic. Thus if an individual travelled to some of these statements, and he went for an enjoyable time, he will find prohibitions and corrupt deeds, people going out dressed immodestly, and public adornments. He will see what gets exposed [from evil] and crimes, while he is unable to change anything, then it Is not permissible to travel in all cases in such a situation. Consequently, the scholars have unanimously agreed that whoever sits in a place that has haram, it is compulsory upon him to condemn it with his hand or tongue. And if he is unable to do so, it is not sufficient that you rebuke it in your heart, you must leave the gathering if you have the ability to do so. And they have unanimously agreed that it is not permissible for you to travel to a place that has haram, while you know that you will not be able to change it. This person goes to a place and knows he will see Haram while being unable to change it, and knows with certainty that he will see haram, not just a high assumption, rather, he has Yaqin that he will see haram, while he is unable to change it. So why would you go there? You have no need or benefit, nor da’wah or ordaining good and forbidding Munkar, nor did you go there to teach, nor did you go for helping anyone, rather you went there for an enjoyable time. He takes his family and children and makes them subjected to temptations and danger. The likes of these people are to be scolded and deterred from doing this and ordered to preserve their din and ‘Aqidah. And if Imam Malik (رحمه الله) would say, that if a person resides in an Islamic land, an Islamic state, an Islamic Khilafah, however in this particular land, many corruptions are found and he is unable to change it, and he is able to travel to another (Islamic) and which condemns corruption, then this is obligatory upon him! Malik views that if someone is under a ruling of an Islamic Khilafah, and there are two (Islamic) lands, one of them is filled with corruption while you are unable to change that, and another land you go to wherein you are able to rebuke the corruption you see, Malik says it is an obligation upon to make hijrah. So imagine if Malik heard about the issues of our times, a land of kufr, a land of prostitution, a land of despicable evil, a land of Zandaqah, a land which promotes corruption and Munkarat. They give Fatawa allowing travel there. These people are Juhhal. He does not have firmly grounded knowledge, nor does he have din. In fact, he cannot even differentiate between Islam and Kufr. He would sit with the kuffar and does not see anything wrong with that, and at times, they would give precedence to the kuffar over the Muslims. These people are to be scolded severely, and not to be allowed to speak in such enormous matters. – Answered by the Hāfidh, Shaykh al-‘Allāmah Sulaymān Ibn Nāsir al-‘Alwān (فك الله أسره) . A little light over the Fatwa: What Sheikh mentioned as ‘urf’, is tradition, which means the law of the land that you can be subjected to tradition without even mentioning them in the contract. such as, he mentioned, to be a soldier. But these things are clearly mentioned as the duties and responsibilities of a citizen for one has to comply to be a citizen. Specifically three duties mentioned that one has to consent in order to become a citizen are: You have to do a ‘Jury Duty’ in a court when you are called. (Meaning you have to participate in the Kuffar’s law) You have to vote in the democratic elections (Meaning, you have to participate in the system of Kufr) You have to join the army if called in an emergency. (Meaning, you have to fight for your Kuffar’s nation even if it is against Muslims, which is Kufr) So, clearly, we became citizens by giving our consent to comply with those clear Kufr acts, unknowingly. Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Rajiun! May Allah protect us from these Kufr acts. And May Allah save us from this. So, my brother, go back and read the Fatwa again and you will have no doubt understanding that obtaining citizenship of a country governed by the Kuffar’s law and consenting to those Kufr act is Kufr. Therefore, Muslims must know that the matter is serious, no doubt about that. We need to stand before our RABB with LA ILAHA ILLA ALLAH both by the intention and by the action. Wa Allahu A’lam! May Allah protect us from Kufr.

t: Background
e: From most shameless “Born Muslim” for 43 years to “Muslim” (who surrenders to the commands, laws, rules, and guidelines in every aspect of life given by The CREATOR, Allah, The All-Powerful, The Most High and The All-Kno
x: From most shameless “Born Muslim” for 43 years to “Muslim” (who surrenders to the commands, laws, rules, and guidelines in every aspect of life given by The CREATOR, Allah, The All-Powerful, The Most High and The All-Knowing) since mid-2013. Alhamdulillah. Praise be to Allah. From browsing and surfing philosophies after philosophies made by men, sometimes under distorted religious shade or “twisted God” they believe in, to the philosophy of the ONE who OWNS the universe! Praise be to Allah. From staying sleepless, night after night, and pulling the hair, engrossed in the quest for the solution, to the evil of human beings and to save the world from destruction to the guidance and peace of the OWNER of the Worlds and all that exists! Al Hamdulillah. From the self-devised philosophy of “stop bringing another human to this world” to surrender to the guidance of the Creator of that human being! Al Hamdulillah, Allah guides whom he wills. From the process of developing a theory of “shaping human child” so as to make every child like one Mandela, Gandhi, and Mother Teresa to submitting to the guidance of the CREATOR of that human being! Subhanallah! From 25 years of engrossing into music, eating, walking, sleeping and dreaming into music and then writing, tuning, and makings songs and then, when it was ready to make 4 albums and 5 more to be ready in the process of being a “star” (as they call it) to engrossing in the passion of the ONE who gave me a passionate heart! Al Hamdulillah! From question after question: Why did ‘God’ not make only ONE religion? Why there are sects in every religion? Why do all religious scholars in each sect, even though they study their religion for 20/40 years, don’t find the correct religion? Is ‘God’ unjust, why did HE put billions of humans in the wrong religion, did HE create them for Hellfire? How would they get the truth? What’s wrong with human beings? From all these questions to the ONE answer given by that SUPREME Rabb, MOST JUST ONE, “the EGO, the root of all evils” (Pride, possessiveness, Overpowering others, Feelings of Inferiority and Feelings of superiority, Feelings of Insult (even innocent advice from others sometimes feels like an insult to the intellect), etc. All these are different forms of EGO that are the causes of human destruction and the other reason being indulged in the ocean of entertainment thus being unmindful and eventually being unaware and UNGRATEFULNESS for the blessing of life, are the answers that I embarked on. From Questions of “What if I would have been born in a ‘Catholic’ family, or ‘Protestant’ family or in another sect of Islam or in a family and community of ‘grave worshipers’ or ‘Idol worshipers’ or ‘Fire worshipers’ or ‘nature worshipers’ or any other religious or non-religious family or community? Had I followed my forefathers and followed the scholars of that sect? How would then I have found the TRUE GUIDELINE from my CREATOR? Did HE make any arrangement for all the humanity born in all these different groups as to how to get ONE TRUE GUIDELINE from HIM? From those questions to the answer, “IF you are a believer what are your BRAINS created for?” From a community of ‘corrupt minds’ who say and preach: “Don’t go into deep into religion, you will get confused” , “ if you believe, only then religion is true, if you don’t believe, then there’s no truth “, “ Reading in Arabic, you at least get a reward brother but reading a translation is what makes Muslims atheist “, “ Are these Ulama wrong? They study Shariah for 40 yrs, dp you think you know better than them ?”, “ Our Shariah is set, our scholars already set rules, you just need to follow them ” “ This is the problem, by studying a few hadith here n there you think you can question them who studied 100,000s of hadith in their entire life ?” From all these blockades and darkness of minds to the light of the ONE who says, “Do you not THINK?” Subhanallah! From “corrupt minds” (a state of mind shaped by the “corrupt philosophies”) to the philosophy of ‘ the Certain Knowledge ’ from the purest sources. From sleepless nights after nights of shading tears for all the good human beings but non-believers to opening pages of “ MankindAtLoss.com ” for the open-heart and open-minded ones and praying to Almighty Allah to guide them.

t: Notes to the Basic Message
e: *1: (Quran 20.14): Indeed, I am Allah . There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance. *2: (Quran 2.185): The month of Ramadhan [is that] in which was revealed the Qur’an, a guidance
x: *1: (Quran 20.14): Indeed, I am Allah . There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance. *2: (Quran 2.185): The month of Ramadhan [is that] in which was revealed the Qur’an, a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion . *3: (Quran 48:29): Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (Quran 33:40): Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah , of all things, Knowing. (Quran 3:144): Muhammad (May Allah exalt his mention) is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. (Quran 47:2): And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad – and it is the truth from their Lord – He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition. *4: (Quran 80.22): Then, when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again). (Quran 83:4): Think they not that they will be resurrected (for reckoning) *5. (Quran 18:48): And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], “You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment.” *6. (Quran 37:21): [They will be told], “This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny.” *7. (Quran 79:36) And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,- (Quran 102: 6-7): You will surely see the Hellfire. Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty. *8. (Quran 26:90, 50:31, 81:31): And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous. And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far, And when Paradise is brought near *9. Quran 83:10-17. Woe, that Day, to the deniers, Who deny the Day of Recompense. No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned. *10. Quran 40:70-72. Those who deny the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers – they are going to know, When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame]. *11. Quran 18:103-106. In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame]. [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work.” Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance. That is their recompense – Hell – for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule. *12. Sahih Bukhari. Vol 9, Book 97. Book of Tawheed. Hadith No.7512 (Darus Salam Publications, July 1997) Narrated ‘Adi bin Hatim: Allah’s Messenger said, “There will be none among you but his Lord will talk to him , and there will be no interpreter between him and Allah. He will look to his right and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward, and will look to his left and see nothing but his deeds which he has sent forward, and will look in front of him and see nothing but the (Hell) Fire facing him . So save yourself from the (Hell) Fire even with half a date (given in charity).” AlA’mash said: ‘Amr bin Murra said, Khaithama narrated the same and added, ‘..even with a good word.’ “ *13. (Quran 102:8): Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure. *14 (Quran 18:49): And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open] , and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, “Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?” And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one. (Quran 99:6-8): That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds. So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it, And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it. *15 (Quran 101:6-11) Muhsin Khan Translations Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy , He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise). But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light , He will have his home in Hawiyah (pit, i.e. Hell). And what will make you know what it is? (It is) a hot blazing Fire! *16 (Quran 8:50) And if you could see when the angels take away the souls of those who disbelieve (at death), they smite their faces and their backs, (saying): “Taste the punishment of the blazing Fire.” *17. ( Sunan Abu Dawood , Vol 5, Book 39, The Book of the Sunnah, Hadith No. 4753; Musnad Ahmad, 18063 al-Albaani in Saheeh al-Jaami’ , 1676.)* It was narrated that al-Bara’ (may Allaah be pleased with him) said: We went out with the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) for the funeral of a man from among the Ansaar. We came to the grave and when (the deceased) was placed in the lahd, the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) sat down and we sat around him, as if there were birds on our heads (i.e., quiet and still). In his hand he had a stick with which he was scratching the ground. Then he raised his head and said, “Seek refuge with Allaah from the torment of the grave”, two or three times. Then he said, “When the believing slave is about to depart this world and enter the Hereafter, there come down to him from heaven angels with white faces like the sun, and they sit around him as far as the eye can see. They bring with them shrouds from Paradise and perfumes from Paradise. Then the Angel of Death comes and sits by his head, and he says, ‘O good soul, come forth to forgiveness from Allaah and His pleasure.’ Then it comes out easily like a drop of water from the mouth of a water skin. When he seizes it, they do not leave it in his hand for an instant before they take it and put it in that shroud with that perfume, and there comes from it a fragrance like the finest musk on the face of the earth. Then they ascend and they do not pass by any group of angels but they say, ‘Who is this good soul?’ and they say, ‘It is So and so the son of So and so, calling him by the best names by which he was known in this world, until they reach the lowest heaven. They ask for it to be opened to them and it is opened, and (the soul) is welcomed and accompanied to the next heaven by those who are closest to Allaah, until they reach the seventh heaven. Then Allaah says: ‘Record the book of My slave in ‘Illiyoon in the seventh heaven, and return him to the earth, for from it I created them, to it I will return them and from it I will bring them forth once again.’ So his soul is returned to his body and there come to him two angels who make him sit up and they say to him, ‘Who is your Lord?’ He says, ‘Allaah.’ They say, ‘What is your religion?’ He says, ‘My religion is Islam.’ They say, ‘Who is this man who was sent among you?’ He says, ‘He is the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him).’ They say, ‘How did you know?’ He says, ‘I read the Book of Allaah and I believed in it.’ Then a voice calls out from heaven, ‘My slave has spoken the truth, so prepare for him a bed from Paradise and clothe him from Paradise, and open for him a gate to Paradise.’ Then there comes to him some of its fragrance, and his grave is made wide, as far as he can see. Then there comes to him a man with a handsome face and handsome clothes, and a good fragrance, who says, ‘Receive the glad tidings that will bring you joy this day.’ He says, ‘Who are you? Your face is a face which brings glad tidings.’ He says, ‘I am your righteous deeds.’ He says, ‘O Lord, hasten the Hour so that I may return to my family and my wealth.’ But when the disbelieving slave is about to depart this world and enter the Hereafter, there come down to him from heaven angels with black faces, bringing sackcloth, and they sit around him as far as the eye can see. Then the Angel of Death comes and sits by his head, and he says, ‘O evil soul, come forth to the wrath of Allaah and His anger.’ Then his soul disperses inside his body, then comes out cutting the veins and nerves, like a skewer passing through wet wool. When he seizes it, they do not leave it in his hand for an instant before they take it and put it in that sackcloth, and there comes from it a stench like the foulest stench of a dead body on the face of the earth. Then they ascend and they do not pass by any group of angels but they say, ‘Who is this evil soul?’ and they say, ‘It is So and so the son of So and so, calling him by the worst names by which he was known in this world, until they reach the lowest heaven. They ask for it to be opened to them and it is not opened.” Then the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) recited (interpretation of the meaning): “for them the gates of heaven will not be opened, and they will not enter Paradise until the camel goes through the eye of the needle” [al-A’raaf 7:40] He said: “Then Allaah says, ‘Record the book of My slave in Sijjeen in the lowest earth, and return him to the earth, for from it I created them, to it I will return them and from it I will bring them forth once again.’ So his soul is cast down.” Then the Messenger of Allaah (peace and blessings of Allaah be upon him) recited the verse (interpretation of the meaning): “and whoever assigns partners to Allaah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky, and the birds had snatched him, or the wind had thrown him to a far off place” [al-Hajj 22:31] He said: “Then his soul is returned to his body, and there come to him two angels who make him sit up and they say to him, ‘Who is your Lord?’ He says, ‘Oh, oh, I don’t know.’ They say, ‘What is your religion?’ He says, ‘Oh, oh, I don’t know.’ Then a voice calls out from heaven, ‘Prepare for him a bed from Hell and clothe him from Hell, and open for him a gate to Hell.’ Then there comes to him some of its heat and hot winds, and his grave is constricted and compresses him until his ribs interlock. Then there comes to him a man with an ugly face and ugly clothes, and a foul stench, who says, ‘Receive the bad news, this is the day that you were promised.’ He says, ‘Who are you? Your face is a face which forebodes evil.’ He says, ‘I am your evil deeds.’ He says, ‘O Lord, do not let the Hour come, do not let the Hour come.’” (Collected from www. islamqa.info/en . Fatwa No. 10403 and www.alifta.com . Fatwa no. 1979) *18. (Quran 70:4) The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years. *19. (80:33-37) Then, when there comes As-Sakhkhah (the Day of Resurrection’s second blowing of Trumpet), That Day shall a man flee from his brother, And from his mother and his father, And from his wife and his children. Everyman, that Day, will have enough to make him careless of others. *20. (Quran 70:10-15) And no friend will ask of a friend, Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help)], – the Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever, etc.) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children. And his wife and his brother, And his kindred who sheltered him, And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him. By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell! *21. Sahih Bukhari . Vol 1, Book 3. Book of Knowledge. Hadith No.128 (Darus Salam Publications, July 1997) Narrated Anas bin Malik: “Once Mu’adh was along with Allah’s Messenger as a companion rider. Allah’s Messenger said, “O Mu’adh bin Jabal.” Mu’adh replied, “Labbaik and Sa’daik. O Allah’s Messenger!” Again the Prophet said, “O Mu’adh!” Mu’adh said thrice, “Labbaik and Sa’daik, O Allah’s Messenger!” Allah’s Messenger said, “There is none who testifies sincerely from heart that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is his Messenger, except that Allah, will save him from the Hell-fire.” Mu’adh said, “O Allah’s Messenger! Should I not inform the people about it so that they may have glad tidings?” He replied, “When the people hear about it, they will solely depend on it.” Then Mu’adh narrated the above-mentioned Hadith just before his death, being afraid of committing sin (by not telling the knowledge). *22. (Quran 4:48) Verily, Allah forgives not that partners should be set up with him in worship, but He forgives except that (anything else) to whom He pleases, and whoever sets up partners with Allah in worship, he has indeed invented a tremendous sin. (Quran 4:117): Verily! (Quran 18:48) *5 . This day is called “THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT” (Quran 37:21) *6 The HELL FIRE will be brought forward (Quran 79:36, 102: 6-7) *7 , the PARADISE will be brought forward. (Quran 26:90, 50:31, 81:31) *8 If YOU DO NOT BELIEVE in your Creator, you WON’T be able to SEE your Creator (Quran 83:10-17) *9 . You will be DRAGGED INTO HELL FIRE (Quran 40:70-72) *10 , even you are the MOST HUMANITARIAN person in this world, your all GOOD DEEDS WILL NOT BENEFIT you. You will LIVE in HELL FIRE FOREVER. (Quran 18:103-106) *11 If you BELIEVE then you will be able to SEE your LORD and HE will TALK to you. (Sahih Bukhari. 7512) *12 HE will ASK you of the blessings HE gave you in this life. (Quran 102:8) *13 You will be given a RECORD BOOK in which you will have every single DEEDS (even it is smaller than an atom) written that you did in this world. (Quran 18:49, 99:6-8) *14 Your GOOD DEEDS and BAD DEEDS will be weighed upon. If GOOD DEEDS WEIGHS MORE you will be admitted into PARADISE. IF BAD DEEDS WEIGHS MORE then you will be taken to HELL FIRE. (Quran 101:6-11) *15 A BELIEVER will be eventually FORGIVEN and taken out from the Hell fire and his final abode will be PARADISE for ever. And every soul will go through the toughness of death, even a believer and righteous person. This is a process that every human soul will experience it’s severity as every mother goes through the agony of giving birth. (Specific References will be mentioned in future InShaAllah) GRAVE : The next stage is Grave. Every human being will be asked 3 questions. Who is your LORD? What is your RELIGION? Who is this man who was sent among you? IF YOU did not take Allah as your lord you won’t be able to answer that question no 1. IF YOU did not follow ISLAM as your religion, you won’t be able to answer that question in no. 2. IF YOU did not follow the guidance came through prophet Muhammad (May Allah exalt his mention), you won’t be able to answer that question in no 3. IF YOU MISS to answer anyone of these questions your punishment will begin straight away and will continue until you are resurrected on The Day of Judgement and you will start getting a TASTE of HELL FIRE right then. But irony of the fact that you will also show a piece of Jannah (paradise) and will be told that this were your home in Jannah had you believed in Allah but now Hell Fire is where you will live forever. IF YOU answer these questions CORRECTLY then you will start getting a TASTE of PARADISE from this moment. (Sunan Abu Dawood, Vol 5, Book 39, The Book of the Sunnah, Hadith No. 4753; Musnad Ahmad, 18063 al-Albaani in Saheeh al-Jaami’ , 1676.) *17 The Day of Judgement: This day is a day of 50,000 years long (Quran 70:4) *18 . In what measure only Allah knows. The agony of the day will be as such, if YOU are the one destined for HELL FIRE, YOU will ask better to start the accounting and reckoning of the day! The intensity of that day is as such that you will flee from your children, your parents (Quran 80:33-37) *19 The FEAR of going to HELL FIRE will be as such that if you are destined for HELL FIRE then you will offer your child to take to HELL FIRE instead of you! (Quran 70:10-15) *20 And IF YOU are the one destined for PARADISE, you will want the reckoning to finish as soon as possible too. The MINIMUM CRITERIA to make PARADISE your final abode: Say sincerely from heart “LA ILAHA ILLA ALLAH, MUHAMMADUR RASULULLAH” meaning “ I reject all objects of worship and I reject anything or any deities (philosophies) that came from human minds EXCEPT the ONE, the CREATOR of heavens and the earths , whose proper name is Allah and Muhammad (May Allah exalt his mention) is the Messenger of Allah” (Sahih Bukhari. 128) *21 And not associating partners in worshipping Allah (Quran 4:48, 4:117) *22 :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: I place you this message to you. Now take your time if you want. Research. Use your brain that your creator gave you to THINK. Wherever you born does not matter, get rid of your limitations and surrender to your creator. Take his guidance as your guidance for life. I pray to Allah, the All Mighty to guide you and help to overcome your ego, arrogance, ignorance, desire, possessiveness, habits and I pray to our creator, Allah, the most JUST to make you a just person to your creator, giving HIM HIS due rights over you.
